charge_port.notes: Native NACS from model year 2027: Electrek (2026-04-29) says the 2027 Blazer EV gets NACS instead of the CCS connector of earlier models; GM says all 2027 EVs get native NACS (Electrek 2026-08-14). Read via press, not a GM page. US only.

supercharger_access.notes: Electrek 2026-08-14: every 2027 GM EV, Blazer EV included, plugs directly into compatible Tesla Superchargers; some sites stay Tesla-only. US only.
